# Sebago (02, engineer) — SPD-014

## Brief
Build cross-repository projects as designed in `docs/design/2026-09-14-cross-repository-projects.md` (Anya, SPD-014), phases A, B and C of its §7.2, in this worktree. Each phase ends with the full suite green (`python3.14 -I -S -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`) and a `member log` line.

Eric's answers to the design's open questions (2026-09-14), which override the doc wherever it assumed otherwise:
1. Sessions in another project are Spud only after `/spud` claims them: `project add` defaults to `--sessions claim`; the home stays `always`.
2. BadTakes' prefixes are `BAD` / `BADS`. Use them in the headless scenarios and any test that stands in for BadTakes (the doc's examples say TAKE / TAKES).
3. BadTakes lands by PR and Spud merges it too (`gh pr merge` once required checks pass). `projects.landing` stays `merge|pr`; no CLI code runs `gh`, and the landing procedure is Spud's prose at merge (§9).

Out of scope, Spud's at merge: every §9 edit (`CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/agents/spudagent.md`, `ledger/Board.base`, `ledger/Fleet.base`, `ledger/Home.md`), `spud migrate` on the real ledger, `project add` / `install` for BadTakes, and the §7.5 acceptance.

Safety: this worktree's `bin/spud` finds the real home through the git common dir. Never run it without `SPUD_HOME` pointed at a scratch home, and never run a migration, `settings sync`, `project install` or `ledger commit` against `/Users/ericlugo/Personal/Spud` or `/Users/ericlugo/Personal/BadTakes`. Your own ledger commands use the ledger root's copy, as always. Headless scenarios run on scratch repositories only, on haiku, with `SPUD_USER_CLAUDE_DIR` in the scratch directory.

Verify the design's six [assumed] claims (G2, G4, worktree-root agent discovery, `disable-model-invocation`, a claim across `--resume`, `ADD COLUMN` with `CHECK` on a STRICT table) through the unit tests and the three scenarios of §7.4, and report each as held or not. Where one does not hold, adapt the implementation within the design's intent and say what changed; if the design cannot stand without a decision from Eric, `member block`.

The parallel variant of §7.2 is yours to use: one child engineer on opus with the single deliverable `tests/test_hooks_projects.py`.
